mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month consecutive decline in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.25 percentage points signals aggressive monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by >0.25pp over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in payroll employment signal a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE down and PAYEMS up) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a rising housing starts (HOUST) above 650,000 units signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 650, or the Rank IC for HOUST in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 95.0 indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer credit (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars signals rising consumer leverage, which precedes positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 400000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 8.0%), a decline in unemployment rate below 8.0% signals labor market improvement, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 8.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both the federal funds rate and the consumer price index (CPI) signal a deflationary monetary policy that reduces real interest rates and stimulates equity demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS down and CPIAUCSL down) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
